materials.title: Choosing a search strategy
materials.bodyMarkdown:
## Choosing a search strategy

Binary search is fast on sorted data, but sorting has a cost. Decide whether the data is already ordered before optimizing.

### Questions to ask

- Is the data already sorted, or does it change often?
- Is a linear scan fast enough for the expected size?
- Can the collection be indexed once and queried many times?
